definitions.explanation: A state or condition without oxygen. Used in scientific contexts for processes that occur without oxygen, and in mountaineering for climbing without supplemental oxygen tanks.

examples.japanese: エベレスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無酸素|むさんそ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{登頂|とうちょう}→登頂：18398_touchou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He summited Everest without supplemental oxygen.

examples.japanese: {無酸素|むさんそ}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短時間|たんじかん}→短時間：18286_tanjikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{筋力|きんりょく}→筋力：16393_kinryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ。
examples.english: Anaerobic exercise is effective for building muscle strength in a short time.

examples.japanese: {無酸素|むさんそ}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生存|せいぞん}→生存：04335_seizon⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In an oxygen-free environment, only certain bacteria can survive.

notes:
USAGE:
The prefix ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧～ means "without" and attaches to many Sino-Japanese nouns. Used in two main contexts: (1) mountaineering — climbing without supplemental oxygen ({無酸素|むさんそ}⟦{登頂|とうちょう}→登頂：18398_touchou⟧), and (2) science — anaerobic conditions or exercise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無酸素|むさんそ}⟦{登頂|とうちょう}→登頂：18398_touchou⟧ (oxygen-free summit, climbing without supplemental O₂)
- {無酸素|むさんそ}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (anaerobic exercise)
- {無酸素|むさんそ}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (oxygen-free state)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有酸素|ゆうさんそ}→有酸素：23848_yuusanso⟧: aerobic — the opposite
- ⟦{有酸素運動|ゆうさんそうんどう}→有酸素運動：23338_yuusansoundou⟧: aerobic exercise
